name: isAgentPolicyEnforced
definition: True when every Tracekit bundle in the window verified intact and its verify report shows no tool call run against a deny or unapproved hold, no unresolved held call, no signed gap, tamper or approval-mismatch record, no observer gap, no fail-open class and no unreconciled call.
population: Tracekit evidence bundles (.tkb) the customer pushed in the evaluation window, each verified by Integration-Service
evidenceRequiredForTrue: Every bundle verified intact, none of the verifier lines policy, held calls, gaps, observers, fail-open classes or coverage warned or failed, and the coverage and fail-open classes lines (which every v2 report carries) passed. A failed or warning line outside tracekit-ai 1.4.2's vocabulary is not measured. It shows decisions were honoured, not that the policy would stop every harmful call.

changeLog.change: Registered with the Tracekit agent evidence transforms; proposed, no requirement reads it yet.

notes: Input is Integration-Service's summary of `tracekit verify --json` (tracekit-ai 1.4.2) per bundle (src/services/tracekit_evidence.py), not a vendor API response. The trust config is Spektrum's, never the uploader's. No integration answers this key yet, so no RTA row maps it.
